Delete your NewApp account

Effective 2026-10-21 · Version 1.0

How to delete your account (in the app)

The fastest way is inside the app:

Settings → Delete Account

Confirm the request there and the deletion process starts immediately.

By email

You can also request deletion by emailing support@newdomain.com from any address, including the app name and, if known, your username. We may ask for information needed to locate the account.

What gets deleted

  • Your account and profile information (name, age, photos, preferences).
  • Your user content, such as posts and, where technically feasible, message content associated with your account.
  • Match history, visitor history, and entitlement/quota records linked to the account.

What we may retain

Records we are required to keep for legal, fraud-prevention, billing, or accounting purposes may be retained in de-identified or minimal form, for example records of purchases processed by the app stores. Retained records are not part of an active profile.

Timing

Account and profile data are removed promptly and in any case within 30 days of a verified request. Some content removal (for example copies in backups) follows the backup rotation cycle.

Deleting vs logging out

Logging out only ends the session on that device — your account and data stay on our servers and the same device sign-in restores them. Deleting the account removes the account and data as described above, and cannot be undone.
